tools.name: get_schedule
tools.about: Race calendar for a season: round numbers, event names, dates, which sessions each weekend has, and whether it has already been run.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.about: Current (or final) driver and constructor championship standings for a season.

tools.name: get_session_results
tools.about: Classification of a session. Races: position, grid, gap to winner, status, points. Qualifying: Q1/Q2/Q3 times. Also weather and each driver's best lap.

tools.name: get_lap_times
tools.about: Every lap of one driver: lap time, sectors, tyre compound and age, position, pit in/out flags and track status (GREEN / SC / VSC / RED).

tools.name: get_race_pace
tools.about: Drivers ranked by representative pace: median of clean laps (green flag, no pit laps, within 107% of the fastest), with gap to the quickest.

tools.name: get_tyre_strategy
tools.about: What each driver ran: every stint with compound, lap range, tyre age at the start and median clean pace.

tools.name: get_tyre_degradation
tools.about: Fitted race pace model: how much slower each dry compound gets per lap of age, pace offset between compounds, the fuel-burn effect, each driver's underlying pace, plus measured pit-stop time loss. A simple linear model; treat the numbers as estimates and check r2.

tools.name: simulate_race_strategy
tools.about: Rank dry-tyre pit strategies for a race by predicted total time using the fitted degradation model and measured pit loss, and show what the winner actually did. Ignores traffic, safety cars and track evolution.

tools.name: compare_drivers
tools.about: Head-to-head telemetry comparison of two laps (each driver's fastest unless lap numbers are given): lap summaries, minimum speed and time gained at every corner, and time gained in each of 25 slices of the lap. Positive gain_a values mean driver A was faster there. Corner-level numbers are indicative (about +/-0.05 s).

tools.name: get_lap_telemetry
tools.about: Telemetry trace of one lap (fastest if no lap number), resampled to `points` evenly spaced distances: speed, throttle, brake, gear, RPM, DRS.

tools.name: list_hud_profiles
tools.about: HUD layout profiles available for video-to-telemetry extraction.

tools.name: render_onboard_video
tools.about: Render a lap from its real telemetry as a view from the car around the real circuit (true corners and elevation; width, kerbs and scenery are stylised) with an instrument cluster showing speed, gear, throttle, brake and revs. Useful as test footage with known ground truth for video_to_telemetry. Returns the file path.

tools.name: video_to_telemetry
tools.about: Read telemetry (speed, gear, throttle, brake, RPM, DRS) out of an onboard video by analysing its HUD graphics, and save it as CSV. `profile` names the HUD layout (see list_hud_profiles); footage with a different HUD needs its own calibrated profile. If a reference lap is given the result is time-aligned to the official telemetry and its accuracy reported. Check speed_read_rate_pct: a low value means the profile does not fit.
